Customs Seize 8 kg Gold Worth ₹11 Crore at Kerala Airports

Indian Customs officials seized approximately 8 kilograms of gold valued at over ₹11 crore across airports in Kerala within a single week. The seizures occurred at multiple airports in the state. Nine individuals have been arrested in connection with these seizures.
